title: VCK members protest in Ariyalur over school caste discrimination
seoTitle: Ariyalur VCK protest against caste bias

tea.why: Protesters demonstrated against alleged caste discrimination and the dumping of human waste in a government school staff room.
tea.want: Demonstrators demanded the arrest of those involved, the filing of a case under the SC/ST Act, and protection for affected teachers.
tea.changed: Nov 23: Police arrested around 175 VCK members following a road blockade and portico demonstration in Ariyalur.

summary: Members of the Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi staged a protest in front of the Ariyalur District Collectorate in Tamil Nadu, demanding action over caste discrimination and the discovery of human waste in the staff room of a government school in T. Keelaveli. According to reports, the controversy involved teachers being isolated and faecal matter being found in their rooms following the Deepavali holidays. VCK cadre gathered outside the Collectorate and in the portico, demanding that a case be registered under the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act and that the accused individuals be arrested. Police intervened, creating barricades, removing protesters who attempted a road blockade, and detaining participants before releasing them later in the evening.
demands: Register a case under the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act
Arrest those involved in caste discrimination and dumping human waste
Ensure protection and justice for affected teachers
response: Police used force to disperse the protesters, dismantled a road blockade, and arrested around 175 VCK members before releasing them later in the evening, according to police sources.

updates.text: VCK members staged a protest in Ariyalur demanding action over caste discrimination and human faeces found in a school.
Police arrested around 175 VCK members following demonstrations at the District Collectorate and released them later.
